headline: Data centers need power
claim: Rising energy costs tied to AI data centers fell hardest on lower-income and rural households.
notes: published 2026-11-09 (Nature Energy; page date read via WebFetch). Cornell's own news release about a Cornell-led study (Fengqi You and Cheng Feng): institution's own work, an interested party. Analysis of 2020-2025 grid costs: data centers covered about 38% ($3.12B of $8.25B) of 2025 grid costs tied to their growth; residents covered the rest. Same study as the CBS News (2026-11-11) and Superpower Daily (2026-11-14) rows.
